answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with an ivory receipt ledger: every honest job mints one ivory receipt chained to the one before, so each identity holds one unforkable history. A raven courier whispers a secret to a random receipt each epoch; only the true holder can echo it in its next job. Clones betray themselves: two identities with receipts branching from the same chain head are pruned together, stake burned. Whispers rotate too fast for farms to rehearse, so splitting one history across a hundred puppets leaves each with a broken chain no merchant trusts.
